verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server and headless API access for agents, but the evidence never shows segment creation through either surface. The listed MCP tasks are campaign creation and flow reports. Composer turning plain language into an audience is an in-app AI feature, not a programmatic surface an external agent can call, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
